rows.grounds: object of the command to hear
compound describing the nectar as the true essence of Kaula
compound describing the nectar as consisting of kāmakalā

items.question: What essential nature characterizes the Kaula nectar the listener is commanded to hear?
premises: The listener is commanded to hear the nectar.
This nectar is identified as the true essence of Kaula.
This nectar is characterized as having the nature of kāmakalā.
items.inference: The Kaula nectar to be heard is the true essence whose nature is kāmakalā.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal nuance of kāmakalā in this context is not fully specified by the verse alone.
items.plain_english: Hear of the nectar, the true essence of Kaula, whose nature is kāmakalā.
